$comment: Project-scoped permissions. Committed so the whole team shares them.
Contains no secrets — allow/deny patterns only.
DESIGN RULE: read verbs are allowlisted, write verbs are not.
The Alpaca CLI is Alpha Preview and has NO confirmation prompts on any
command, so a blanket Bash(alpaca:*) would silently authorise
'alpaca position close-all'. Order-placing and position-closing commands
are deliberately absent from allow and, for the two destructive ones,
explicitly denied so they always surface.
